subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir repeatedly deflected the Medusa's petrifying gaze by shoving an ice mirror in her face.
source_quote: Zalthir had demonstrated remarkable composure, repeatedly deflecting the creature's deadly petrifying gaze by shoving an ice mirror in her face

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir maintained the restraint expected of his order despite the Medusa's venomous taunts about his draconic heritage and the circumstances of his birth.
source_quote: Despite her venomous taunts about his draconic heritage and the circumstances of his birth, the monk maintained the restraint expected of his order

subject: Daz
fact: Daz delivered the final blow with magical missiles that struck true and ended the Medusa's life.
source_quote: The final blow came from Daz, whose magical missiles struck true and ended the creature's life

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool expressed unusual delight at tasting the Medusa's remains.
source_quote: Glabbagool, the intelligent gelatinous cube who traveled with them, expressed unusual delight at tasting the Medusa's remains

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum volunteered to place the Ruby spell gem into the great menhir in the temple's center.
source_quote: Grygum, as the party's cleric, volunteered to place the Ruby spell gem that Gerdig Katfinger had provided into the great menhir that stood in the temple's center

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was startled as an Earth Elemental materialized behind him.
source_quote: so too did another Earth Elemental, startling Grygum as it materialized behind him

subject: Daz
fact: Daz cast a mesmerizing pattern of swirling colors that incapacitated the Earth Elemental.
source_quote: Daz quickly cast a mesmerizing pattern of swirling colors that incapacitated the creature, freezing it in place

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir rushed forward and delivered a devastating series of blows that left the elemental severely wounded.
source_quote: Zalthir rushed forward and delivered a devastating series of blows that left the elemental severely wounded

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum followed with a brilliant flash of divine light that struck the creature with tremendous force, reducing it to rubble.
source_quote: Grygum followed with a brilliant flash of divine light that struck the creature with tremendous force, reducing it to rubble

subject: Galeb Duhr
fact: The Galeb Duhr explained that by defeating the elemental, the party had freed it from Ogrémoch's control.
source_quote: the creature spoke in measured tones, explaining that by defeating the elemental, they had freed it from Ogrémoch's control

subject: Galeb Duhr
fact: The Galeb Duhr could do nothing until all of its brothers were similarly freed.
source_quote: However, it could do nothing until all of its brothers were similarly freed

subject: Galeb Duhr
fact: The Galeb Duhr revealed that Ogrémoch had infected the temple and prevented these guardians from performing their sacred duty to protect it.
source_quote: The Galeb Duhr revealed that Ogrémoch had infected the temple and prevented these guardians from performing their sacred duty to protect it

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin intercepted one of the elemental's attacks during the second battle.
source_quote: Thorin intercepted one of its attacks

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin engaged the second elemental directly with his glowing sword Dawnbringer.
source_quote: Thorin engaged it directly with his glowing sword Dawnbringer

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum unleashed a powerful spell with his crossbow, channeling divine energy through the weapon to pierce the elemental's stony hide and destroy it.
source_quote: Grygum unleashed a powerful spell with his crossbow, channeling divine energy through the weapon to pierce the elemental's stony hide and destroy it

subject: Daz
fact: Daz unleashed a massive explosion of fire that scorched the third elemental.
source_quote: Daz unleashed a massive explosion of fire that scorched the creature

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took a moment to drink a healing potion from the party's supplies before preparing to rejoin the fray.
source_quote: Zalthir, wounded from the previous fight, took a moment to drink a healing potion from the party's supplies before preparing to rejoin the fray

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin positioned himself to intercept the third elemental's charge, striking it twice with devastating precision as it rushed toward him.
source_quote: Thorin positioned himself to intercept the elemental's charge, striking it twice with devastating precision as it rushed toward him

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin drew upon his reserves of strength to launch a flurry of additional attacks, each one chipping away at the elemental's defenses.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir stepped forward and delivered an enhanced strike that shattered the third elemental into fragments.
source_quote: Finally, Zalthir stepped forward and delivered an enhanced strike that shattered the creature into fragments

subject: The temple's cleansing
fact: The party's work in cleansing the temple was far from complete, as another Galeb Duhr materialized after the third elemental fell.
source_quote: as the dust settled, yet another Galeb Duhr materialized from the stone, suggesting that the party's work in cleansing the temple was far from complete
